mean_proof_uses: Each route has uniform target-index marginal; linearity of target-weighted CE and finite permutation averaging.
mathematical_expected_objective_minimize: Same as COMMON wherever defined; does not imply equal finite optimizer endpoints.
covariance_identity: Cov(shuffled|H)=Cov(COMMON|H)+E_view Cov_assignment(shuffled|H,view), positive semidefinite extra term for finite moments.
cross_route_target_covariance: -C_Q/3 for distinct routes under a uniform4-target bijection.
more_informative_than_COMMON_alone: Yes for persistence attribution because instantaneous target concentration/support/entropy multiset matches ROUTE; COMMON remains the deterministic average reference.
remaining_confound: Temporal assignment continuity/state association and gradient noise/Adam moments change.

prior_judgment: Stochastic averaging, contrastive target selection, multiple shared views and matched assignment controls are established ancestry; exact complete-rule duplication unresolved, no novelty claim.

cost_claim: Same model operation counts; assignment/indexing/replay metadata overhead must be charged, no measured wall-time claim.
decision: Retain as inactive additional persistence control, not a replacement for COMMON or an automatic fit/source step.
